messages:
natalie (sec-pm): Hey team — product asked for a demo/template for requesting short-lived SIEM extracts (for dev debug + vuln triage). They want to know what fields we need, approvals, and KMS unwrap flow. Can someone draft a minimal example we can hand them?

kai (eng-sre): I can sketch one. Quick Q: is this for internal triage only or a partner/share? that changes redaction/PII steps.

natalie (sec-pm): internal only for now. devs + oncall. No partner sharing.

marco (infra): Good. For internal short-lived dumps we typically require: requester, reason, timebox (start+ttl), dataset scope (query/hash), approved-by (security & oncall), and retention after dump (auto-delete). Also require KMS key id if unwrapping needed.

kai (eng-sre): Draft template in YAML below (feel free to copy):
```
requester: natalie@example.com
team: payments-api
purpose: vuln triage - reproduce error 
scope_query: "service:payments AND trace_id:abc123"
window_start: 2025-06-03T10:00:00Z
ttl_hours: 24
approved_by: [security-eng, oncall]
preserve_evidence: false
kms_key_id: projects/redwood/keys/siem-unlock
notes: "need decrypted export for stacktrace correlation"
```

devon (oncall): TTL 24h is fine. Make sure the ticket links back to the incident ID so we can re-correlate. Also require an oncall signoff comment like: "I verified scope and approve minimal extract".

sarah (legal): For internal triage we still need to know if any user identifiers are in scope. If PII could be present add a line: pii_expected: yes/no and require minimization plan.

natalie (sec-pm): Nice — what about the KMS unwrap? ops wants to avoid manual CMK unwraps.

marco (infra): We use a proxy service to unwrap under an ephemeral role. Flow: request -> ticketing webhook -> automated workflow checks approvers -> if approved, ephemeral service-account is granted kms:Decrypt for a single CMK invocation -> service performs unwrap and streams masked export to a short-lived S3 location with server-side encryption (SSE-KMS) -> ACL is restricted to the requester + security team for TTL window -> lifecycle policy deletes after ttl. No human copy of plaintext stored.

security-bot: Playbook link: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/ephemeral-siem-extracts (checks: approvers, ttl, pii flag, audit log).

kai (eng-sre): Minimal approval matrix: Security Eng (must), Oncall (must), Product Owner (if >48h TTL or partner data), Legal (if pii_expected == yes), Infra (if requires CMK unwrap). Add a frictionless path for emergency incident triage: an incident token with short-lived elevated approval for oncall + security.

devon (oncall): Example approval comment we use: "approved - scope looks minimal, ttl 24h, no exports outside infra, incident #INC-1234". Put that exact string into the ticket.

natalie (sec-pm): Can you also provide example of what we'd log for audit?

kai (eng-sre): Audit entries (one-line for the ticket system):
```
AUDIT | ts=2025-06-03T10:05:12Z | actor=kai | action=request_export | ticket=E-4321 | scope=service:payments AND trace_id:abc123 | ttl=24h | approvers=security:alice,oncall:devon | kms_key=projects/redwood/keys/siem-unlock
AUDIT | ts=2025-06-03T10:10:01Z | actor=automation | action=unwrap_and_store | ticket=E-4321 | s3=arn:aws:s3:::redwood-temp/e-4321 | lifecycle_deletes=2025-06-04T10:10:01Z
```

marco (infra): Also capture the ephemeral role issuance and the CMK Decrypt API call in CloudTrail (or equivalent) and link that ID in the ticket. That's important for later forensic review.

sarah (legal): If a request ends up touching PII unexpectedly, escalate and pause deletion. We may need a legal hold. Put a checkbox on the form: "pause_on_pii_discovery" default: true.

natalie (sec-pm): This is great. Can we make a one-click template in the ticket UI that populates the fields and sends webhook to the automation?

kai (eng-sre): Yep, trivial. I'll prepare a sample JSON payload the webhook expects: 
```
{
  "ticket_id": "E-4321",
  "requester": "natalie@example.com",
  "scope_query": "service:payments AND trace_id:abc123",
  "ttl_hours": 24,
  "approvers": ["security:alice","oncall:devon"],
  "kms_key_id": "projects/redwood/keys/siem-unlock",
  "preserve_evidence": false
}
```

devon (oncall): One more ops rule: no exports with full request/response bodies containing auth headers. The automation should scrub Authorization, Cookie, and set a mask list.

marco (infra): Agreed. Masking rules: remove headers, replace email/user ids with hashed tokens unless explicitly needed. Save a hashed mapping to the ticket log for re-identification by Security only.

natalie (sec-pm): Thanks all — I'll publish this as the "short-lived internal SIEM extract" template and add the mandatory fields you mentioned. Will ping again when the ticket UI template is live. :thumbsup:

security-bot: Updated playbook draft saved at https://redwood.internal/playbooks/ephemeral-siem-extracts/draft-v2 (automated diff: added pii flag, webhook example, audit entry examples).
